basis: Defined by developmental, behavioral and learning impairment following prenatal nicotine exposure; other organ damage is not established as common.
Alcohol-induced fatty infiltration of liver parenchyma; no other organ is intrinsic to this diagnosis.
Inherited susceptibility to persistent cutaneous papillomavirus infection defines the skin and immune disorder.
The supplied subtypes arise in bone, tendon-associated tissue or soft tissue; no additional organ involvement is established across this group.
Cerebellar channelopathy with episodic and progressive ataxia; nystagmus, diplopia and vertigo reflect central dysfunction rather than separate eye or ear damage.
Disorders located in the cornea; infectious and immune mechanisms apply only to subsets of this umbrella.
Treatment-resistant hematopoietic or lymphoid malignancy; lymphoma and extrahematologic organ damage are not universal across the umbrella.
Developmental delay 15/15; hip dysplasia and scoliosis each 2/2; strabismus 3/7. VSD 3/17 is below threshold; macrodontia alone does not establish dental dysfunction.
Intellectual disability defines the disease; strabismus affects 2/5. Joint hypermobility 5/5 does not by itself establish musculoskeletal damage.
Circadian sleep-wake regulation disorder; blindness is a predisposing condition, not damage caused by the disorder. Altered melatonin timing is not endocrine gland disease.
Allergic immune-mediated inflammation of the conjunctiva and cornea.
Benign tumor arising in the adrenal gland; hematopoietic tissue within the tumor does not constitute a blood disorder.
Type II collagen skeletal dysplasia; functionally significant myopia/vitreoretinal abnormalities occur in roughly 40-50% or more in major forms. Hearing involvement varies by subtype.
Inherited T/B-lymphocyte deficiency defines SCID. Bronchiectasis, cutaneous infections and autoimmune hemolytic anemia are separately diagnosed complications.
Defined by disrupted amino acid metabolism; no additional organ damage is established across this broad group.
Nonsyndromic progressive sensorineural hearing loss, reported in 6/6 patients.
Urate metabolic disease producing crystal-induced autoinflammatory arthritis; nephrolithiasis and chronic kidney disease are separate diagnoses.
Mesenchymal soft tissue neoplasm; the definition provides no consistent additional organ of origin or involvement.
Progressive central neurodegeneration with cerebellar and cerebral involvement; optic atrophy is reported without evidence that it reaches 30% in this subtype.
Inherited epidermal disorder causing blistering and recurrent annular scaling; no other organ damage is established.
Infiltrating urothelial carcinoma originating in the bladder, which belongs to the renal axis.
Neuroendocrine tumor arising in the appendix wall; glucagon-like peptide production alone does not establish an endocrine disorder.
The sparse record identifies ankle defects with short stature, supporting skeletal involvement; no definition or phenotypes establish other organs.
BCOR-altered sarcomas predominantly arise in bone and soft tissue; visceral or CNS sites are not characteristic of most patients across the group.
Intellectual disability affects 11/13. Asthma in 4/13 is a separate disease; hypotonia does not establish primary muscle damage, and skeletal abnormalities are individually below 30%.
